item.title: Why The Avalanche Bringing Back Nazem Kadri Is So Significant In The NHL's Central Division Battle
item.description: The Colorado Avalanche brought back Nazem Kadri, one of the centers who helped them win the Stanley Cup in 2022. Their center depth is now very strong in a division with two other Cup contenders.

item.title: Blues GM Blasts Parayko Trade Offer Leaking Before He Declined To Waive No-Trade Clause
item.description: St. Louis Blues GM Doug Armstrong told reporters they did some due diligence as soon as reports came out about an agreement in place to trade Colton Parayko to the Buffalo Sabres, which the D-man later struck down.

item.title: NHL Trade Deadline 2026: The Five Biggest Winners
item.description: The NHL's trade deadline passed Friday afternoon. Five teams had the best performance, including buyers and sellers.

item.title: Penguins' Evgeni Malkin Suspended Five Games For Slashing Sabres' Dahlin
item.description: Evgeni Malkin slashed Rasmus Dahlin in the head during Thursday's game between the Pittsburgh Penguins and Buffalo Sabres.

item.title: Exclusive: NHLPA Boss Marty Walsh Reacts To Possible Expansion, Upcoming CBA Changes
item.description: NHL Players Association executive director Marty Walsh sat down for an exclusive interview with THN.com. In this file, Walsh discusses NHL expansion, the impact of the new labor agreement, and the league's positive trajectory. Here's Pt. 2 of the exclusive Q&A.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Top Trade Candidates Who Didn't Move At The 2026 Deadline
item.description: St. Louis Blues center Robert Thomas, New York Rangers center Vincent Trocheck, and Florida Panthers goaltender Sergei Bobrovsky were among the notable names in the trade rumor mill. So why didn't they get moved by the trade deadline?

item.title: 'You Lay In The Bed You Make': Maple Leafs React To Selling At Trade Deadline
item.description: For the first time in the Auston Matthews era, the Toronto Maple Leafs were sellers at the trade deadline, experiencing a new feeling and realization.

item.title: NHL Trade Deadline 2026: The Five Biggest Losers
item.description: The NHL's 2025-26 trade deadline passed on Friday, and certain NHL teams missed key opportunities, squandering cap space and trade assets they could've used to improve. Which franchises fumbled badly at the deadline?

item.title: Did The Rangers Do Enough At The NHL Trade Deadline To Kick-Start Their Retool?
item.description: The New York Rangers are retooling, and at this year’s deadline, they owned the most sought-after player in Vincent Trocheck. They elected not to trade him, but will they come to regret that decision?

item.title: Top Five Stanley Cup Contenders Following The NHL Trade Deadline
item.description: Which teams surged after the NHL’s trade deadline on Friday? Here are our choices for the NHL’s top five Stanley Cup contenders after the deadline.
